a.title: mirror the app layout for Arabic: settings, chat and the loose files in src
a.body: Part A of a three-slice right-to-left migration. Converts settings, chat and the loose files under src: physical direction utilities become logical ones, directional icons get an rtl: counterpart, and the workspace control bar is re-anchored.

b.title: mirror roster, usage and onboarding for right-to-left
b.body: Part B of the same migration, stacked on part A. Converts three folders part A did not touch: roster, usage and onboarding. Two components stay left-to-right islands because they compute physical pointer and chart coordinates.

source: v1: isnadi-bot #101 and #102, the two halves of one migration. They are one area at two scopes, which the same_feature task explicitly says is not the same feature - treating them as duplicates would have dropped half the migration.
